body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{crit}}\)
body.construction: Pull both inner and generated-pushforward equations into treated-post coordinates using def:nested-derivative; retain the harmonic projection \(\mathcal H_P\); freeze only \(B\) at each Green pole; subtract the anisotropic logarithmic fundamental solution with a smooth cutoff; split the smoothed response into radii below a fixed multiple of \(h_n\), between that radius and a fixed positive radius, and outside that radius; control coefficient, generated-target, moving-pole, lift-branch, and harmonic-score errors with weighted Schauder estimates; and close the stochastic expansion with a quadratic \(C^{1,1/4}\) remainder under a small \(C^{2,1/4}\) perturbation.
